Alana (People Ops): Quick update: auditors asked us to split SOC2/ISO uploads into staggered lanes next month to smooth reviewer load. Please confirm evidence owners by EOD tomorrow. Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/compliance/2026-audit-window :eyes:
Jordan (Security): Thanks. Do the lanes change what we need to collect or only when we hand it over?
Alana (People Ops): Timing only. Same checklist. This just prevents a single-day upload surge and helps the audit team schedule deep reviews.
Ravi (Eng): Can you paste the lane breakdown? Small teams might need to coordinate cross-team owners.
Alana (People Ops): Lane A (week of 2026-05-04): Runtime, Serving. Lane B (week of 2026-05-11): Platform Infra, SRE, Observability. Lane C (week of 2026-05-18): SDKs, DevEx, Docs. Lane D (week of 2026-05-25): Sales, Support, GTN (controls-only).
Lisa (Legal): Reminder: redact PII per the standard redaction checklist before uploading. Legal will spot-check samples.
Ravi (Eng): Evidence owner for Runtime: Ravi K. Ill upload runbooks, access matrices, and the incident playbook by Friday. Any preferred formats?
Alana (People Ops): PDFs for policies, CSV manifest for inventories. For large logs, zip and keep chunks under 500MB; include README.txt describing file contents and hash. Tag uploads as `evidence_2026_<lane>_<team>`.
Jordan (Security): We'll review Runtime and Infra bundles for Lanes A/B. Also adding a KV/secret handling checklist to the manifest template.
Marta (People Ops): Leads, please update the Confluence owner table with your confirmed owner by EOD tomorrow so we can lock the schedule. :calendar:
Lisa (Legal): If you need redaction help, ping legal-help and include a link to the doc in your upload note.
compliance-bot: Reminder scheduled for 2026-04-28 09:00 UTC: "Confirm evidence owner in Confluence"
Ravi (Eng): Confirmed owner noted in Confluence.
Jordan (Security): Confirmed from Security review side.
Alana (People Ops): Thanks, team. We'll run a 30-minute office hours drop-in on 2026-04-29 16:00 UTC for upload questions; recording will be posted to the Confluence page. :thumbsup:
